council: Bath and North East Somerset Council
current_evidence: B&NES has no downloadable local list: its 'Local requirements for planning applications' page (the breadcrumb parent of every checklist) indexes a separate web checklist per application type, and neither it nor the checklists show any adoption/update date (only 'Copyright 2026').

issues.detail: Grokbot's 'Validation list URL' and 'Planning page' are the checklist for ONE application type (Outline application with all matters reserved), not the local list. The URL is also on the old beta.bathnes.gov.uk subdomain and 302-redirects to www.bathnes.gov.uk. The local list is the index page https://www.bathnes.gov.uk/local-requirements-planning-applications, which links to about 30 application-type checklists.
issues.evidence: Index page: 'Once you know your type of application, you can view the local checklist for documents you'll need to supply below.' beta URL -> 302 Found -> https://www.bathnes.gov.uk/outline-application-all-matters-reserved

issues.detail: Full planning: the council checklist names 32 local documents, but Grokbot captured only a handful, mostly taken from inside the Sustainable Construction Checklist. Grokbot missed these, all under the checklist's general trigger 'may need to include' (each linked guidance page gives the detailed trigger): Accessibility Standards for Market Housing Proposals Checklist; Affordable housing statement; Air Quality Assessment; Artificial Pitches Management Plan; Biodiversity and Geological Conservation Assessment; Biodiversity Net Gain Assessment; Building for a Healthy Life Assessment; Coal Mining Risk Assessment; Embodied Carbon Assessment; Environmental Statement; Flood risk assessment; Flood Risk Sequential Test Evidence; Foul Sewage Assessment; Heritage Statement; HMO Energy Performance Certificate; Land contamination assessment; LVIA; Lighting assessment; Noise impact assessment; Open space assessment; Planning Statement; Purpose-Built Student Accommodation Statement; Economic (Regeneration) statement; Statement of Community Involvement; Transport assessment; Travel plan (draft); Tree survey/Arboricultural statement; Ventilation and extraction statement; Viability Assessment; Waste Management Plan - Post Construction.
issues.evidence: https://www.bathnes.gov.uk/full-planning-application: 'full planning applications may need to include the following supporting documents' (32 items listed)

issues.detail: Householder is marked '(none) - national requirements only', but the householder checklist lists 3 local items: Biodiversity and Geological Conservation Assessment; Flood risk assessment; Parking and access arrangements as part of a Design and Access Statement. B&NES also publishes separate checklists for Householder + listed building consent and Householder + demolition in a conservation area.
issues.evidence: https://www.bathnes.gov.uk/householder-application-checklist: 'Householder applications may need to include:' Biodiversity and Geological Conservation Assessment; Flood risk assessment; Parking and Access Arrangements, as part of a Design and Access Statement

issues.detail: Listed building consent is marked '(none)', but the LBC checklist lists 6 local items: Biodiversity and Geological Conservation Assessment, where work affects areas such as vaults or roof space; Heritage Statement; elevation drawings at 1:10/1:20 and section drawings at 1:1, 1:2 or 1:5 for work that alters or installs architectural features such as doors and windows; Stone cleaning survey, for any stone cleaning or paint removal; Structural survey/report, where the work affects structural integrity; Damp Remediation Report from an independent specialist, where the work remedies damp.
issues.evidence: https://www.bathnes.gov.uk/listed-building-consent-checklist: 'Any proposal to carry out stone cleaning and or/removal of paint should be accompanied by a pre-cleaning survey'

issues.detail: Outline and Reserved matters each have only 2 rows (Drainage, S106), both taken from the Sustainable Construction Checklist. The outline (all matters reserved) checklist lists 30 local documents, including Affordable housing statement, Air quality, BNG, Coal Mining Risk Assessment, Ecological survey, Environmental statement, Flood risk assessment and sequential test, Heritage statement, Land contamination, LVIA, Lighting, Noise, Open space, Planning obligations/draft heads of terms, Planning Statement, PBSA statement, SCI, Transport assessment, Travel plan, Tree survey, Ventilation and extraction, Viability and Waste management plan.
issues.evidence: https://www.bathnes.gov.uk/outline-application-all-matters-reserved: 'this type of application may also require that you need to submit the following' (30 items)

issues.detail: Several Full/Outline/Reserved-matters rows are sections of the Sustainable Construction Checklist relabelled as separate requirements, with garbled triggers. 'Design Code / Masterplan / Parameter plans' is jumbled two-column text about policy SCR6 and is not a masterplan requirement. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' is Table 8 (Water) of the checklist, not a drainage strategy. 'Planning Obligations / S106 draft Heads of Terms' is Table 2.2 ('Proposals for more than one dwelling type') and has nothing to do with heads of terms. 'Water efficiency' is the checklist's 110 l/p/d tick-box. 'Ventilation / Extraction details (odour)' is the indoor-air-quality section, while the real local requirement is the separate 'Ventilation and extraction statement'.
issues.evidence: Grokbot S106 trigger: 'Table 2.2 - Proposals for more than one dwelling type ... Required for developments with more than one type of dwelling where compliance is to be proposed for the whole site'

issues.detail: Grokbot never states when the Sustainable Construction Checklist applies, and its 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' trigger is scrambled table text ('% Residual carbon reduction individually not met by energy from energy efficiency...'). The council page says the checklist is required for: new-build residential of 1+ dwellings (including replacements, co-living, student accommodation, holiday lets and HMOs); major non-residential new build of 1,000 m2+; medium-scale or larger works to existing buildings (5+ dwellings / 500 m2); and district heating proposals. There is no exemption for listed buildings, and residential schemes must also submit an Energy Summary Tool.

'Archaeological Assessment' and 'Ecological Survey' were taken from the Mineral extraction checklist page and placed under Full planning as 'INFERRED'. The Ecological text also cites the superseded Conservation (Natural Habitats etc) Regulations 1994. The Full planning checklist covers these through the Heritage Statement and the Biodiversity and Geological Conservation Assessment instead. Almost every Full planning row carries the same 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' note.

Both tab_items are boilerplate from the Sustainable Construction Checklist SPD, not requirements: 'The checklist should accompany documents that provide further detail...' and 'The tables set out in this PDF document are representative and editable documents are available separately.' The 'Validation checklist form (completed)' row has the fragment trigger 'Type of application required to submit the Checklist 2'.
issues.evidence: tab_items source: Sustainable Construction Checklist SPD finalCS.pdf (2024-12)

issues.detail: Every other application type (Advertisement consent, Demolition in conservation area, S73 variation, NMA, Lawful development certificates, Discharge of conditions, PiP, Prior approvals, Works to trees, S106 modification) is shown as '(none)'. B&NES publishes a dedicated local checklist page for each, and Grokbot read none of those pages (e.g. advertisement-consent-application, removal-or-variation-condition, approval-details-reserved-condition). Their individual contents were not checked in this audit.
issues.grok_comment: The '(none)' rows are mostly wrong. For example, the S73 page lists an Accessibility Standards checklist, and Demolition in CA lists Heritage Statement, Planning Statement, BNG and tree survey. But Grokbot did capture these pages (raw/ has 25817b026a, d092e4b371, 709b8601c4, 9994e49378 and the CLU pages), so it is wrong that "Grokbot read none of those pages".
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. Grokbot fetched these pages but did not map their content, so the (none) rows are still wrong. Reworded as a mapping failure, not unread pages.

issues.detail: Grokbot read the superseded 2023-01 Sustainable Construction Checklist SPD PDF on the beta subdomain and used it as the source of the Ventilation row. The council now links the 2024-12 'SPD finalCS' version and checklist templates updated in 2025-06.

summary: Grokbot linked a single outline-application checklist on a redirecting beta URL rather than B&NES's undated web-based local requirements index, and its extraction is mostly fragments of the Sustainable Construction Checklist relabelled as other requirements. Most real local requirements are missing, and Householder and LBC wrongly show 'none'.
